principles: Only fix the real wrapper-root correctness UX; do not broaden signed-workspace resolution semantics.
Keep Lattice host-neutral: CLI policy and validation own the repair, hosts only run visible commands.
Fail closed whenever the candidate repository is absent, outside metadataRoot, not a git root, or ambiguous.
Separate read-only diagnosis from mutating repair so operator intent stays explicit.
drivers: B-3938-style parent metadata root plus child git repo layouts currently require manual inference after failure.
Existing configured gitRoot resolver path is already authoritative and should be reused after config is written.
Command policy/process fact registries must remain consistent for any new CLI surface.

options.name: A: Add config doctor suggestion plus explicit confirmed config repair command
pros: Solves the user-visible path from diagnosis to repair without changing runtime resolution semantics
Keeps host-neutral authority in Lattice CLI
Can be covered by existing wrapper-root smoke harness
cons: Adds one mutating CLI command and registry entries to maintain

options.name: B: Make story_resolve/review_run_start automatically choose a nested child repo
pros: Would make the immediate failure disappear without a separate command
cons: Silently guesses material root in ambiguous layouts
Makes host/runtime behavior harder to audit

options.name: C: Leave error message as-is and document manual gitRoot edits
cons: Does not fix the real UX gap the user hit
Continues requiring manual config edits and path inference
Harder for multi-host agents to execute consistently

chosen: A: Add config doctor suggestion plus explicit confirmed config repair command
rationale: Option A fixes the concrete wrapper-root repair path while preserving fail-closed runtime behavior and host-neutral command authority.

preMortem.scenario: Doctor suggestion becomes de facto automatic resolution
preMortem.trigger: Implementation feeds the single child candidate into story_resolve/review_run_start without config write
preMortem.consequence: Signed workspace can change silently and violate authority expectations
preMortem.mitigation: Keep candidate detection only in lattice_config_doctor output; resolver continues to use explicit gitRoot or story worktree only.

preMortem.trigger: --set-git-root allows absolute outside paths or non-git directories
preMortem.consequence: Config can point at unrelated material root and produce invalid review evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Validate normalized relative path stays under metadataRoot and git rev-parse top-level equals target before writing.

preMortem.trigger: Doctor or repair chooses first candidate in a wrapper with several repos
preMortem.consequence: Wrong repository may become signed workspace
preMortem.mitigation: Doctor reports ambiguity and no repair suggestion; repair requires explicit provided path and validates it only.

preMortem.scenario: New command is invisible to policy checks
preMortem.trigger: CLI schema/alias added without command policy/process-fact-level entry
preMortem.consequence: Phase tools, observability, and contract verification drift
preMortem.mitigation: Update COMMAND_POLICIES, PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS, aliases/read-only classification as appropriate and run process contract verification.
